ModMetaData.name: Props in Use
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Decorative props that already look like something useful, made to actually be that thing.
Prop mods are full of objects that stop at the picture. A guitar on a table is scenery; a fountain in a garden is scenery; a hedge grown from anima bark is scenery. This mod plugs a handful of them into the systems they were clearly drawn for, and changes as little else as it can: same texture, same place in the build menu. Costs are left alone except for the troughs, which is explained below.
WHAT IT DOES
- Miniature Props and Decor: the nine instruments on its prop shelf become playable instruments through Musical Instruments (Continued). A colonist walks up, sits down and plays. The metronome is left alone. - Miniature Props and Decor: the handheld game console and the ham radio become recreation sources — dexterity play and solitary relaxation. Both already sat in a file called Buildings_Recreation with no recreation type on them. - Alpha Props - Parks and Gardens: the seven ornamental fountains become natural meditation foci, scaled by size, and stop counting as artificial construction near other foci. - Alpha Props - Parks and Gardens: the anima and gauranlen hedges already carry a meditation focus strength that nothing in the game ever reads. They now feed that strength into nearby anima trees, animus stones and nature shrines, and likewise stop counting against them. - Alpha Props - Parks and Gardens: the five troughs become animal feeders. The game ships no feeder of any kind, so hay goes on the barn floor and rots there. Feed stored in a trough does not deteriorate, which is what lets the trough stand out in the pasture rather than under a roof. Animals eat straight from it.
WHY THE TROUGHS COST WOOD
A trough had to change its thingClass to hold storage, and the one it had was the class Vanilla Furniture Expanded uses to charge silver at build time. Losing it would have made the troughs free, so they are given 25 wood and 400 work instead - cheaper than a shelf, and without its research. All five are converted, the three filled with plastic flowers included: one function, five looks.
Every change is a guarded patch. If a source mod is absent, its patch does nothing and reports nothing. Nothing here contains another author's files.
No save data of its own. Adding it mid-save is safe; removing it leaves props that are once again only props - empty the troughs first, or whatever they hold will be left loose on the ground.
